items.claim: Commercial-design-win momentum is broadening faster than disclosed scaled production economics are becoming visible.

finding: The newest Cadence supplier-primary evidence independently confirms a DSP licensing/design win inside Aeva 4D LiDAR, but expressly does not establish OEM PPAP, homologation, purchase volume, realized revenue, series-production acceptance, production ramp, unit economics, gross-margin economics, or scaled recurring production economics.
reason: The input is new but does not address the exact production-economics fact required to adjudicate the existing material contradiction. Preserve the gate and await genuinely new source-addressed scaled-production economics; do not repeat the prior supplier-scope adjudication.
